description: This file implements the core logic of a Tic-tac-toe game, including game state representation, move validation, winner detection, and game flow control. It defines classes for the game board, the game itself, and interfaces for user interaction and opponent types, with methods supporting gameplay mechanics.

classes.name: Board
classes.description: Represents the 3x3 game board, storing the state of each cell as an empty string or 'X'/'O'.

classes.name: Game
classes.description: Maintains the current game state, including the board, current player, mode, and computer's mark, with methods for move management and game status checks.

classes.name: Prompter
classes.description: Interface for user input, defining a Select method to prompt for user choices.

classes.name: GameInterface
classes.description: Interface exposing method to retrieve available positions on the board.

methods.name: NewGame
methods.description: Creates a new game instance with specified mode, initializing the empty board and setting the starting player.

methods.name: MakeMove
methods.description: Attempts to make a move at the specified row and column, updating the game state if valid.

methods.name: GetWinner
methods.description: Checks all winning conditions to determine if there is a current winner.

methods.name: IsBoardFull
methods.description: Returns true if all board positions are filled, indicating a draw.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representation of the current game board with color styling.

methods.name: GetPlayerMove
methods.description: Prompts the user for a move using the supplied prompter, ensuring the move is valid.

methods.name: IsComputerTurn
methods.description: Returns true if it's the computer's turn based on the current mode and player.

methods.name: GetComputerMove
methods.description: Determines the computer's move using a simple strategic algorithm.

methods.name: findWinningMove
methods.description: Checks for a move that would result in a win for the specified mark.

methods.name: positionToRowCol
methods.description: Converts a 1-9 board position to zero-based row and column indices.
